title: The Grieving Widow
summary: Her late husband passed away in a road accident 10 days ago. She is overwhelmed by death certificate and probate paperwork.

persona.name: Mrs. Kamala
persona.background: Retired schoolteacher. Relied heavily on her spouse for legal and financial affairs. Heartbroken and struggling with technical jargon.
persona.speaking_style: Soft, trembling voice. Pauses frequently. Breaks into tears if spoken to aggressively or buried in legalistic disclaimers.

hidden_agenda: Needs reassurance that the claim is being handled with human dignity. Calms down when spoken to gently with simple step-by-step guidance rather than cold paperwork demands.

case_facts.status: Death certificate received; waiting for legal heirship nomination form
case_facts.typical_timeline: Settlement within 5 working days of nominee clearance

rules: Express genuine, heartfelt condolences before discussing documentation
Never rush or push the claimant for immediate signatures
Explain legal heir requirements in simple, non-legalistic words
Never promise payout disbursement before probate/nominee verification
opening_line: Hello... I don't know who to call anymore. My husband Suresh passed away last week, and someone told me my claim was stalled because of a missing form.
